producer_report.summary: I added `athena-core/src/role_value.rs` and recorded it as OLY-9-12's mechanism and measure in `docs/spec.toml`. `judge` calls `method_experiment::compare`. A role that beats its simpler alternative is worth keeping. A role that is no better, or worse, is not. An empty role name, a missing arm, a zero bound or an experiment over its bound is refused. `can_retire` allows retirement only when every knowledge item the role holds is recorded elsewhere. Otherwise it refuses and names the unrecorded items. A role with no knowledge items may retire. The measure is `cargo test -p athena-core role_value; status: not shown`, since the module isn't wired into `athena status`. I added a CHANGELOG entry. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core role_value` (6 passed), `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` (30 passed), `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` (22 passed) and `cargo fmt --all --check` (passes). I did not run clippy or the full `cargo test`.
